memories.content: A new charge nurse, Priyanka Shah, started on Mara's unit a few weeks before 2026-05-18 and reorganized the entire night-shift rota without consulting the people who work nights, putting Mara on a stretch that disrupts her sleep.

entities.name: Priyanka Shah
entities.description: new charge nurse on Mara's unit; over-eager to fix things

memories.content: As of 2026-05-18, Mara and her colleague Priya Nair planned to jointly talk to charge nurse Priyanka Shah about the night-shift rota change, with Priya (who has known Priyanka longer) brokering the conversation.

entities.name: Priya Nair
entities.description: Mara's nursing colleague; has known Priyanka Shah longer

entities.name: Priyanka Shah
entities.description: new charge nurse on Mara's unit

memories.content: Mara holds a positive view (2026-05-18) of her colleague Priya Nair but a reserved 'jury's out' view of new charge nurse Priyanka Shah; she distinguishes the two similar-sounding names as 'priya nair good, priyanka shah jury's out'.

entities.name: Priyanka Shah
entities.description: new charge nurse Mara is unsure about

memories.content: Mara works night shifts as a nurse and believes (2026-05-18) night shifts are fundamentally different from day shifts ('nights aren't days with the lights off'), so scheduling for them needs different consideration.

entities.name: Priyanka Shah
entities.description: charge nurse Mara wants to understand this
